params.target: y = ln(max(RV, 1)), RV in tick^2; natural log

baseline.kind: climatological quantiles of y, training period

calibration.fee_per_var: ratio of sums: sum fair pips / sum rv over the calibration hours, 1e18-scaled, so fee_for_var(rv) totals the fair fee unclamped
calibration.expected_var: midpoint-weighted mean of exp(mix quantile) over the K levels (Vincentized reputation-weighted mix), tick^2 1e18-scaled
calibration.fair: LVR break-even fee: (sigma_hour^2 / 8) * 2*L*sqrt(P) / hour's swap volume in token1, sigma_hour^2 = real realized_vol * 18/11 * ln(1.0001)^2 (12/11 to a full hour, 3/2 for the 2/3 variance of window-mean differences)
